name: The Peninsula Shanghai
positioning: Art Deco-inspired luxury hotel at No. 32 The Bund, opened in 2009, with rooms looking over the Bund, the Huangpu River or the Pudong skyline
best_for: Travelers who want a base on the Bund with river and skyline views
Guests interested in Art Deco design and Shanghai history
Diners interested in Northern Italian cooking and Japanese tempura

facts.text: The hotel opened on the Bund in 2009.
The hotel sits at the far end of the Bund, on the western bank of the Huangpu River.
The hotel pairs Art Deco-inspired interiors with contemporary comfort.
Rooms look over the forecourt, the Bund or the Pudong skyline.
Deluxe Garden Rooms look towards the historic Garden Bridge across Suzhou Creek.
The Astor Suite has a 115 sq m terrace with a private whirlpool tub and views over the Bund and the Huangpu River.
Sir Elly's Restaurant serves Northern Italian cuisine high above the Bund, with views across the Bund.
Sir Elly's wine list has over 400 labels.
Sir Elly's Terrace is a rooftop bar on the 14th floor.
The indoor heated swimming pool has an Art Deco fireplace.
The Peninsula Spa holds a Five-Star rating from Forbes Travel Guide 2026.
Sir Michael Kadoorie, the hotel's owner, has forebears who came to Shanghai from Baghdad in the mid-19th century.

highlights.text: The Schindler Group produced a replica of a 1930s antique lift, originally housed in the Belgian Lift Museum in Brussels, for the hotel.
The hotel owns four Extended Wheelbase Rolls-Royce Phantoms, six BMW Peninsula Editions and a seven-seat Mercedes-Benz Sprinter, all finished in Peninsula Green.
The Rosamonde Aviation Lounge celebrates the history of aviation in China with a collection of antiques and memorabilia, including a life-size replica of the Leoning at its entrance.
The Palace Suite has a 1,098 sq m terrace, which the hotel describes as the largest private terrace on the Bund.
TAKIYA SHANGHAI is the first international outpost of TAKIYA, a Japanese tempura restaurant.

considerations.text: All indoor areas are non-smoking and the hotel no longer offers smoking guest rooms.
Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult at the pool.
WhataHotel notes the historic Bund location can get heavy tourist crowds during peak seasons.
